context: Daichi and Mei enjoy a quiet moment at home with children sleeping.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Mei and the kids are all asleep now.
lines.style: Warm, content Kansai lilt threading through. Soft reporting tone — the satisfaction of a full house finally at rest. Gentle, real warmth, no performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: That's good. It's been such a kind day.
lines.style: Soft, genuine appreciation in the voice. No rush. Settles into the warmth of the moment with him. Tender exhale — the ease of being truly seen.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Family really is a treasure, isn't it.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with philosophical weight underneath. Not a statement — almost wondering aloud. Genuine tenderness, no sentiment. The voice of a man holding something precious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Being together like this — it's really happiness.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not explaining, just confirming what they both know. Soft depth in her voice. The safety of saying something true because he's listening.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Direct, unhurried Kansai warmth. Opens his chest to say it. Not rushed or performed — the quiet confidence of someone saying what matters most, unguarded.
